description: The requests you have sent and the requests on your own offer, each with its status. Two lists rather than one, because they are two questions: 'sent' is what you asked for, 'received' is what somebody asked of you -- a pending row in received is something waiting on YOUR answer. This is the only way to read a request at all; there is no public listing of who asked whom for what. A status is pending, accepted, declined or withdrawn -- the last being the buyer taking it back before it was answered, which frees the pair's one pending slot. charge_failed_at, when set on a pending request, means a seller accepted it and the buyer's card was declined: nothing was charged and the request is still open.
name: get_my_requests
title: Your requests, both directions
